question: Estimate monthly sales of small-ticket loans (personal loans, BNPL <₹50K) in a single Tier 2 city like Lucknow.
idealClarificationQuestions: Loans <₹50K disbursed monthly (BNPL, instant personal loan, app-based credit)? Yes.
All digital fintech + bank disbursals? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Adults × digital lending penetration × monthly transaction frequency.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average disbursals per active borrower per month: ~0.5 (some monthly, most quarterly).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average ticket size for small-ticket loan: ₹18,000.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~1.5 lakh loan disbursals / ~₹27 Cr monthly in Lucknow.
